notice.content: From Mirasol Pharmacy we ask you NOT to send us sensitive information about your health or private documentation, such as prescriptions and/or other personal medical documents. In any case, we can confirm that the mobile device is only for this functionality and is located in a private area. The device is configured with all available security options and all received and sent messages are periodically deleted. No documents and/or messages are stored at any time.
